title: Generate
lead: Each shot gets a few takes, auto QA scores them, and you just pick. Rerun or switch models when you are not happy — older takes are kept.

cards.label: Queues and QA
cards.shotCap: Per-shot cap {{cap}}; above it you are asked first

wall.label: Takes
wall.title: Takes for shot {{id}}
wall.keys: ← → switch takes · Space play · 1–5 rate · A adopt

note.fallback_timeout: Local timed out, fell back to API

empty.running: {{model}} is making take {{n}}. It is checked automatically and then shows up here.
empty.queuedDub: The lines are voiced with the locked voice first, then the picture is generated.
empty.queuedText: On-screen text is added in post, so this take has no lettering.
empty.waiting: Waiting for {{id}} to be adopted: this shot starts from the last frame of {{id}}.
empty.none: No takes yet. Click “One more take” to start.

toast.adoptedWarn: {{id}}: adopted T{{n}} (note: {{fails}} QA checks failed; you chose to keep it).
toast.play: Playing {{id}} T{{n}} (the demo data has no video files).
toast.fix: Circle the area to fix in the picture; only that region is redrawn (local H3 + mask inpainting).
toast.upLocal: Sent {{id}} T{{n}} to 2K finishing ({{model}}); runs locally, no charge.

rules.title: Auto rules
rules.retryBefore: When QA fails, rerun automatically up to
rules.retryAfter: times, then switch models per the fallback settings
rules.capBefore: When a shot would cost more than $
rules.thresholds: QA thresholds: face match ≥ {{face}} (against the locked reference) · lip-sync confidence ≥ {{sync}} · dialogue character error rate ≤ {{cer}} · on-screen text must match exactly (OCR) · the vision model checks for defects and whether the picture matches the description.

log.title: Run log
log.switch_pass: You tried another model → {{model}} made T{{take}}{{cost}} · QA passed
log.switch_fail: You tried another model → {{model}} made T{{take}}{{cost}} · {{fails}} failed
log.fallback_timeout: Local job ran over {{minutes}} min → fell back to {{model}}
log.fallback_error: Local job failed → fell back to {{model}}
